## About Me

I work at the intersection of **data science, econometrics and financial analysis**, with a particular interest in quantitative modelling, time-series analysis and risk.

My projects use tools such as **Python, R and SQL** to move from raw data to interpretable results, with an emphasis on clear methodology and reproducible analysis.

## Areas of Interest

- Data Science and Machine Learning
- Econometrics and Time Series
- Financial Risk and Portfolio Analysis
- Quantitative Research
- Data Analytics and Visualization
